text.p: Brokerage UBS lowered its recommendation on French glassmaker Saint-Gobain to 'sell' from 'neutral' and cut its earnings estimates for the group, fund managers said on Friday.
UBS judged Saint-Gobain's 1996 results disappointing and believes the stock overvalued, they said.
Natwest Sellier maintains its "hold" recommendation on Saint-Gobain after the group announced 1996 results in line with its expectations, one broker said.
It believes that despite a "sharp improvement" in other sectors, the poor situation of the building sector will hurt glass activity.
Dupont Denant maintains its "overperform" recommendation" on the stock.
Saint Gobain said on Thursday 1996 net attributable profit would be 4.32 billion francs, up slightly from 4.21 billion last year.
Saint Gobain was off 0.24 percent to 846 francs at 1055 GMT.
